summary: Monday sets record foreign buying and a firm domestic trend against a deep US tech sell-off and fresh Gulf attacks, with monthly expiry crammed into the only session before Tuesday's holiday.

detail.leaders: Banks, which carried last week's rally on heavy foreign buying, if the inflows keep coming
detail.laggards: IT and AI-linked names after Nvidia's slide in the US; oil-sensitive sectors if crude reacts to the Gulf
detail.tone: The week ended on a long winning streak led by banks, but the weekend brought a US tech rout and attacks on tankers and Bahrain. Domestic news was quiet; the Gulf was the evening's only fresh development.
